column4: Everything to install, use and run E-KO RIP Center: server, Mac, Linux and Windows clients, mobile app and Cloud.
How the server, clients, mobile app and Cloud fit together, then setting up a print shop in five steps.
Choose the computer, install the RIP server on Ubuntu from the APT repository, create accounts and connect the machines.
Install and connect the E-KO RIP Center client on Mac, Linux and Windows.
Follow production from an iOS or Android phone and get machine alerts.
Reach the print shop's RIP server from outside, with no VPN and no open port, through the free platform.e-ko.rip.
Sending a job, the queue, printing, cutting, proofs, sheets, colour and media: every feature of the RIP.
The supported printers, cutting plotters and cutting tables, how to add them and connect them.
Connect and set up the Epson SC-S80600: direct driver, media, loaded media, common trouble.
Connect the Roland VersaCAMM and send it the cut over the network.
Connect the Kona over USB, set up cutting and registration with frame and barcode.
Connect the Graphtec FC7000 and send it the cut in HP-GL.
Cutting tables and preparing the sheets meant for them.
Accounts, backups, updates, shared folders, advanced settings and server data.
Common messages, their cause and what to do.
RIP and wide-format printing terms, explained simply.
